cities.label: Florence
cities.intro: Dog-friendly Florence: the stair-free route up from the Ponte Vecchio side, fenced dog runs (aree cani), and local etiquette.

route.title: Stair-free route to Piazzale Michelangelo (David) & the Rose Garden
route.hint: The usual walk up uses the Scalinate del Poggi — beautiful stone stairs, brutal with a dog on a leash. Take the winding road instead; it is stairs-free the whole way.

steps.title: The river stroll
steps.text: Leave the apartment and head east along the south bank of the Arno via Lungarno Torrigiani and Lungarno Serristori. Flat, easy walking with wide sidewalks.

steps.title: The turn
steps.text: At Piazza Poggi (the square with the giant stone tower) do NOT take the stairs — turn right onto Viale Giuseppe Poggi.

steps.title: The winding incline
steps.text: The road winds gently up the hillside with a wide paved pedestrian sidewalk under shady trees. A steady climb, completely free of stairs.

steps.title: Rose Garden side gate
steps.text: About halfway up, the upper side gate of the Giardino delle Rose lets you in with the dog on a leash — paved paths and skyline views.

steps.title: The summit
steps.text: Exit back onto the sidewalk and follow the final bend of the road straight into the panoramic plaza of Piazzale Michelangelo (David on the steps).

spots.name: Area Cani Carraia
spots.why: The closest dedicated dog park to the route up the hill. Fully fenced municipal green space just outside the old city walls: mature tree canopy shade, wooden dog-agility structures and picnic tables.
spots.maps: Area Cani Carraia, Via dell'Erta Canina, Firenze

spots.name: Parco delle Cascine
spots.where: West of the centre, along the Arno
spots.why: Florence's largest park — the 'Central Park' of the city. Miles of paved and dirt trails plus a large dedicated off-leash dog area (Area Cani Cascine) for socializing.

spots.name: Orti del Parnaso
spots.where: North of the river, near Giardino dell'Orticoltura
spots.why: Multi-tiered hillside park famous for its giant mythical dragon fountain. Hugely popular with local dog owners: uncrowded Duomo views and a well-used fenced dog enclosure.

spots.name: Piazza della Repubblica
spots.where: The exact heart of the historic center
spots.why: Wide, flat, pedestrianized and dog-friendly with a leash. Good spot for an outdoor table at a historic café and people-watching without the cobblestone crowds.

etiquette.title: Trams & buses
etiquette.text: Dogs ride Florence public transport on a short leash; carry a muzzle anyway — drivers and passengers can request it.

etiquette.title: Water on the walk
etiquette.text: It gets warm. Bring a collapsible bowl and refill at the city's small public fountains (fontanelli) around the squares.

etiquette.title: Leash rules
etiquette.text: Off-leash only inside the fenced aree cani. Historic center and gardens generally require leashes.

etiquette.title: Outdoor dining
etiquette.text: Most trattorie with outdoor tables happily take a small leashed dog; ask 'Il cane può venire fuori?' before sitting.

cities.label: Lucca
cities.intro: Lucca is one of Tuscany's easiest cities to bring a dog to: the flat, shaded park on top of the walls and the Serchio river park are both daily dog culture, and there are several fenced sgambatoi (off-leash runs).

route.title: The Mura loop — the big Lucca dog walk
route.hint: The 4.2 km traffic-free green rampart on top of the Renaissance walls: grass and gravel, double rows of plane trees for shade, benches everywhere, no roads to cross. Leash required; this is where Lucca walks its dogs.

steps.title: Start at a gate
steps.text: Porta San Donato is closest to Via Fillungo and most central stays — steps lead straight up onto the wall-walk by the arch. Any of the 10 gates works.

steps.title: Walk the ramparts
steps.text: Follow the continuous elevated promenade: 360° views over rooftops on one side and hills on the other, small fountains along the way for a dog water break.

steps.title: Rest on a bastion
steps.text: The wide bastion platforms are shaded rest stops; further along, horses graze in the Horti Del Lucchese section — give them distance.

steps.title: Finish at the river
steps.text: Come down near the north side and drop to the Parco Fluviale del Serchio for proper off-leash running.

spots.name: Parco Fluviale del Serchio (area cani)
spots.where: Via delle Piagge 250 — north of the walls
spots.why: The local dog hub: large listed off-leash area with shade, agility equipment, separate zones, water, benches and parking; grassy river trails for long walks.
spots.maps: Parco Fluviale del Serchio, Via delle Piagge, Lucca

spots.name: Area sgambamento Via Passamonti
spots.where: Via Eugenio Passamonti 252 (San Concordio, east edge)
spots.why: Clean, well-maintained fenced run: water fountains, shade, benches, roomy grass and agility gear — reported to have a proper gate, unlike some Lucca aree.

spots.name: Le Mura (wall promenade)
spots.where: The ring around Lucca's old town
spots.why: Not a dog park, but the flat, shaded 4.2 km loop is the city's social dog walk — leashed, stroller-and-dog friendly, benches throughout.

spots.name: Parco della Pace
spots.why: Small well-kept park with water; no dedicated fenced run, but quieter open patches on the north side.
spots.maps: Parco della Pace, Via della Formica, Lucca

etiquette.title: Leash in town
etiquette.text: Historic center, the Mura walkway and all piazzette require a leash; Lucca is very dog-tolerant as long as the lead is on.

etiquette.title: Where off-leash is OK
etiquette.text: Inside the fenced sgambatoi and the river-park dog areas — that's where dogs actually run; the Serchio park is the practical pick from the center.

etiquette.title: Heat & water
etiquette.text: Same kit as Florence: collapsible bowl; fountains on the walls and in the parks. Midday on the Mura has gaps in shade — dawn/dusk walks are better in warm weeks.

etiquette.title: Dining with the dog
etiquette.text: Outdoor tables on the piazzette are relaxed about a leashed dog under the chair; Trattoria Canuleia's garden and Da Quartuccio's sidewalk set are good bets.
